oneOf.description: Every arm ran: what each counted, and the gate.

arms.description: The base's replay, the base asked again, and the draft.

card.description:
A description's that may: the question it asks whatever the numbers say, and what to weigh.
Null for any other.

exempt_conflicts.description:
The conflicts of each mapping the base refused, which the gate can't judge: a key
reading the wrong column merges entities there unseen, so the person approving sees
them.

gate.description: Whether the draft may go to a person.

shifts.description:
What the draft did to each link whose facts it changed, the biggest loss first: the
gate lets a new link take from its neighbours, a description's card leaves all of it
to a person, and the person approving sees what.

usd_micros.description: What the paid arms spent, in millionths of a US dollar.

oneOf.description: The draft changes what it may not; nothing ran.

proposal.description: What it proposes instead, if anything: the question a person answers.

oneOf.description:
The base's replay needed a call these documents' artifacts don't hold: they aren't the
base's extraction of them.

doc_ids.description: The documents whose replay asked a model.

oneOf.description: The paid arms spent `max_usd` before both finished.

usd_micros.description: What they spent, in millionths of a US dollar.

oneOf.description: An arm couldn't run: its rows didn't load, a document failed, or a store failed.

usd_micros.description: What the paid arms spent before it ended, in millionths of a US dollar.

oneOf.description: The caller went away.

Advisory.description: What a person weighs on a description's card: it stops nothing.

oneOf.description: This check couldn't have refused harm to this link: too little of it in the documents read.

The draft's own words accept a quarter or more under what its link's name does, past one
fact: it may describe something other than its link.

by_name.description: The link's facts judged by its name.

oneOf.description:
Its reports stopped past the noise, and only the draft's own words say something came of
them: the one judge that reads the draft. A draft that hushes part of a link while widening
its words elsewhere reads the same.

by_name.description: What came of them by name, past its noise: too little.

own_words.description: What came of them in its own words, past its noise.

stopped.description: The reports stopped past their noise.

oneOf.description:
What the draft is held to didn't move as meant past its noise. Its link's facts read by
name against the fresh arms, its reports against the replay.

Another count moved past its noise, in the draft by name: another link's facts against a
noise pooled over every link, reviews by reason, violations, or the link's own reports
rising.
Relationships no link covered, but this link's, moved in total past their noise.

Arms.description: A Check's arms, over the same documents and row sample.

base_fresh.description: The base bundle, every call asked again.

base_replay.description: The base bundle, every call replayed from the documents' artifacts: $0.

draft.description: The draft bundle, asking only the calls it changed.

more_fresh.description:
The base bundle, asked again further times: a description's draft has
[`FRESH_ARMS_OF_A_DESCRIPTION`] fresh arms in all, and any other draft one.

Brief.description:
What a drafting turn is asked to change ([`Brief::goals`]), and so what its draft may
change ([`crate::allowed`]).

oneOf.description:
Documents state a relationship no link covers, which a person asked to have: add a
link for it, or route or describe an existing one so documents state it.

names.description: What the documents' extractor called it.

oneOf.description: A mapping's rows don't compile, or its source changed: map its fields again.

Documents state a relationship their routes let them, yet the extractor didn't use the
link: describe it so it does (P5.0's lever).

Canonical.description:
A suggested link's canonical form (P5 D11): lowercased, each run of characters other than
letters and digits one `_`, none at either end. Never empty.

CardQuestion.description:
What every description's card asks: nothing deterministic tells a draft that changed what its
link means from one that says it better, so a person is asked. Said as the question's text.

oneOf.description: Whether the link still means what it meant.
oneOf.const: Does this link still mean what it meant? Confirm that the new description only says it better, and doesn't change what the link is for.

oneOf.description:
Document reviews of a reason, but `unresolved` and `unmatched`, which count alone: this
count of either is 0.
Reviews of names no rung of resolution resolved, of a type.

Relationships no link covered, of any of these suggested links: spelled so, or begun by
one of them that is the longest declared name the suggestion starts with.
A link's facts.
The facts with an end of a type.
The quotes documents gave of a link's facts.
The document reviews of a link's facts.
A mapping's row errors.
What a mapping's rows state.
The rows that create an entity of a type.
The entities rows created of a type.
The different values a type's entities hold of a property, not a key's.
Entity properties a later row of a mapping gave another value.
Open violations.

Counts.description: What one arm counted over a Check's documents and rows.

conflicts.description: Entity properties a later row gave another value, by mapping.

links.description: The links the arm's bundle declares, with facts or not.

prop_values.description:
How many different values entities hold of each property, by type and property, but
its key's. Different, so merging rows that agree keeps them. It sees a binding dropped,
not a false merge: other entities can hold both values, which `conflicts` is for.

quoted.description:
Quotes documents gave of each link's facts: they rise where a document restates a fact
rows hold, which adds no fact.

refused.description: The mappings validation refused, which loaded nothing.

reviewed.description: Document reviews of a fact of each link: stated by the extractor and left for a person.

reviews.description: Document reviews by reason, but those `unresolved` and `unmatched` count.

row_errors.description: Rows, or parts of rows, that compiled to nothing, by mapping.

rows.description: Rows that create an entity of each type.

stated.description:
What each mapping's rows state: the entities and property values each row gives, and the
facts the load wrote of them. A mapping that didn't load states nothing.

touching.description: Facts with an end of each type, once each.

unmatched.description: Relationships no link covered, by their suggested link's canonical form.

unresolved.description: Reviews of names no rung of resolution resolved, by the type they were named as.

Demand.description:
Who asked for a new link: the only kind of brief no signal makes alone (P5 D11).
P5.11b adds Ask's typed schema gaps.

oneOf.description: A person asked to draft a fix of the finding.

DescriptionCard.description:
What a description's card shows the person who decides.

`Check` judges a changed link by its name, so a description can't vouch for what it asked for:
`by_name`, [`Self::reviews`] and every [`Advisory`]'s draft read that way. The load after
approval judges by the description: `own_words` is what it would hold. All of them count the
documents the check read, a sample.

advisories.description: What to weigh: what moved past its noise, and what the check couldn't see. It stops nothing.

base.description: What the link held before the draft, and each number's noise.

by_name.description: The link's facts each judged by its name.

gathered.description: What was gathered under the link's name.

own_words.description: The link's facts each judged by the draft's description: what the load would hold.

question.description: What the card asks the person to confirm.

reviews.description: Every review reason against its noise.

Disallowed.description: Why a draft can't go further as it is.

oneOf.description: It takes away what the base holds.

item.description: The item, as a dotted path of its table.

oneOf.description: It changes what only a person may decide, which becomes this question.
It changes what its brief doesn't ask for.

item.description: The item, as a dotted path of its table.

ExemptConflicts.description:
The conflicts of a mapping the base refused, for the person who approves a draft: the gate
doesn't judge them.

conflicts.description: Entity properties a later row of it gave another value, in the draft.

Gate.description: Whether a checked draft may go to a person.

oneOf.description: It does what it was drafted for, within the noise otherwise.
It doesn't.

GatheredReport.description:
One canonical form of the reports gathered under a name they only start with: what lets a
person see what was grouped (`country_of_residence` under `country`). Lowercased and
normalized: a suggestion's raw text isn't kept.

count.description: How many reports had this form.

quote.description: One of them: the text it is about.

GatheredReports.description:
The reports gathered under a link's name, of the documents the check was sent: how many, and
the commonest forms of them. Empty for a finding spelled as it is.

forms.description: How many canonical forms they took.

shown.description: The commonest forms, at most [`GATHERED_SHOWN`], then by name.

Origin.description: Where a draft's proposal came from.

oneOf.description: A signal proposed it ([`propose`]), and its target is what the signal reported.
A person asked for it, no signal behind it.

OwnBase.description:
What a description's link held before the draft, each number with its noise: what `by_name` and
`own_words` read against, and what says whether a hard refusal could have fired.

fresh.description:
Its facts in the base asked again, by name, the middle of those arms: what `by_name` reads
against.

fresh_noise.description: Their noise: how far those arms spread, or how far a count of that size moves.

replay.description: Its facts in the base's replay, judged by the base's words: what `own_words` reads against.

replay_noise.description: Their noise: pooled from every other link and arm.

reports.description: Its reports in the base's replay.

Proposal.description:
A change to the bundle a finding proposes, only ever an addition (P5 D4): route links, or a
draft of a [`Brief`]; or the question a change only a person may make becomes.

oneOf.description: Add `links` to what the routes covering `set` let its documents state.

gathered.description:
Whether a report behind it was gathered under a declared name it only starts with
([`crate::Relations`]). The gathering rule can be wrong (`country_of_residence` under
`country`): a person's reading of the quotes is the only check, so layer 3's `Auto`
must leave such a route in the queue.

links.description: The links to add, each one the ontology declares and the set's routes lack.

set.description: The document set whose documents state the relationship.

oneOf.description:
Draft a change of the bundle to `brief`, by a revision turn, to be checked
([`crate::allowed`], then `Check` and [`crate::gate()`]) before a person approves it.

brief.description: What the draft is to fix.

origin.description:
Who it's for: which targets it may be held to depends on it ([`Proposal::aimed`]). A
proposal that doesn't say is a finding's.

oneOf.description:
Ask a person what only they may decide: what a draft that would loosen or tighten the
bundle becomes ([`crate::Disallowed::Asks`]).

Question.description:
A change only a person may make: what a draft that loosens or tightens the bundle's
guarantees becomes instead of a change (P5 D4), a question on the card.

oneOf.description: Should the link hold one object per subject, or many?
Must every subject have the link?
Should the constraint check what it checks, at its severity?
Is the type identified as it is?
May the route's documents create entities of the type?
Should the rule derive what it derives? Drafts write no rules (P5 D8).

Should the mapping read, bind or let through what the draft says: another table, a
binding made optional, a report made a create? Each can stop the row errors a draft was
asked to fix.

ReviewsMoved.description:
One reason's reviews against their noise, shown whichever way they went: a description's change
re-asks every section, so they move, and only a person can say what that means here. The
draft's count is judged by name, as every paid arm's, and the base's replay by its words.

SetId.description: The id of a document set, such as `set_01JDX4K2`: 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, `_` or `-`.

Shift.description:
What a draft did to a link's facts, for the person who approves it: a new link's draft is
judged on the other links' total, and this says which of them lost what.

base.description: Its facts in the base replay.

Undetected.description:
Which hard refusal a check couldn't have made: its base held no more than its noise, so even
losing all of it moves nothing past the noise.

oneOf.description: Its link's own facts collapsing. A hush would still show in its reports.
Its link's reports stopping. A hush would still show in its facts.
Either: a total hush of this link would reach a person unrefused.

Why.description:
The guard a draft failed, with the count's base (replayed), draft and noise. [`Harm`] is the two
of them that refuse a description's draft: the clear harm [`crate::described`] filters, in a
type of its own, so nothing advisory can stop a draft.

oneOf.description: The target didn't move as meant beyond the noise.
Violations rose beyond the noise.
A link's facts fell beyond the noise.

A new link's draft: the other links' facts fell in total past their noise, by as much as
its own links gained or more. It took what it stated, and added nothing.

added.description: What the draft's own links gained past their noise.

base.description: The other links' facts in the base replay.

oneOf.description:
What the load states fell beyond the noise, a mapping's conflicts rose, a type's entities
rose past the rows creating them, or another count moved.

A count that says what the load lacks fell past the noise, and too little explains it: the
draft stopped the report, not what it reported.

evidence.description: What rose that could explain it, past its noise.

oneOf.description: Relationships no link covered, but the target's, moved in total beyond the noise.
